description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 2 consecutive strikes, dealing Glacio DMG.

Basic Attack - Necessary Measures

With Moldable Crystals, Carlotta's Basic Attack is replaced with Necessary Measures.
Chain up to 3 strikes, dealing Glacio DMG. Each strike of Necessary Measures consumes 1 Moldable Crystals.

Heavy Attack

Deliver a charged attack at the target at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack - Containment Tactics

When Carlotta's Substance is full, her Heavy Attack will be replaced with Containment Tactics: consume all Substance to deal Glacio DMG and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill Art of Violence by 6s.

Mid-air Attack

Perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG. Using Basic Attack shortly after the landing will cast Customary Greetings.

Mid-air Attack - Customary Greetings

Flip over the target and deliver a surprise shot, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to deliver a riposte shot, dealing Glacio DMG. This consumes 1 Moldable Crystals.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 2 serangan beruntun, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Basic Attack - Necessary Measures

Dengan Moldable Crystals, Basic Attack Carlotta digantikan oleh Necessary Measures.
Menyambung hingga 3 serangan, memberikan Glacio DMG. Setiap serangan Necessary Measures mengonsumsi 1 Moldable Crystals.

Heavy Attack

Melancarkan serangan isi ke target dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack - Containment Tactics

Saat Substance Carlotta penuh, Heavy Attack-nya digantikan oleh Containment Tactics: mengonsumsi seluruh Substance untuk memberikan Glacio DMG dan mengurangi cooldown Resonance Skill Art of Violence sebesar 6 dtk.

Mid-air Attack

Melakukan Plunging Attack dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Glacio DMG. Menggunakan Basic Attack sesaat setelah mendarat akan melancarkan Customary Greetings.

Mid-air Attack - Customary Greetings

Melompati target dan melepaskan tembakan kejutan, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk melepaskan tembakan balasan, memberikan Glacio DMG. Ini mengonsumsi 1 Moldable Crystals.

description.en:
Deal Glacio DMG and inflict Dispersion on the target. Press Resonance Skill again shortly after to cast Chromatic Splendor.

Dispersion

Targets with Dispersion are immobilized for 1.5s.

Chromatic Splendor

Consume all Moldable Crystals and deal Glacio DMG.
The Resonance Skill enters cooldown after a while if Chromatic Splendor is not cast or Carlotta is switched off the field.
description.id:
Memberikan Glacio DMG dan menimpakan Dispersion pada target. Tekan Resonance Skill lagi sesaat setelahnya untuk melancarkan Chromatic Splendor.

Dispersion

Target dengan Dispersion tidak dapat bergerak selama 1,5 dtk.

Chromatic Splendor

Mengonsumsi seluruh Moldable Crystals dan memberikan Glacio DMG.
Resonance Skill memasuki cooldown setelah beberapa saat jika Chromatic Splendor tidak dilancarkan atau Carlotta diganti keluar dari lapangan.

description.en:
Deal Glacio DMG to all targets in an area (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and inflict Deconstruction on targets hit, then activate Twilight Tango.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Deconstruction

Dealing DMG to targets inflicted with Deconstruction ignores 18% of their DEF.

Twilight Tango

While in Twilight Tango, press Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to cast Death Knell.
Each Death Knell grants 1 Meta Vectors.
With 4 Meta Vectors, press Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to cast Fatal Finale.
- All Substance is removed when activating and ending Twilight Tango. Cannot perform Basic Attack Necessary Measures, Heavy Attack Containment Tactics, and Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion while in Twilight Tango.

Death Knell

Carlotta fires powerful shots with her musket and summons 4 crystal shards to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
- Carlotta moves in the direction of the movement input with each shot of Death Knell.

Fatal Finale

Deal Glacio DMG to an area, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
- Twilight Tango ends after casting Fatal Finale.
description.id:
Memberikan Glacio DMG ke semua target di suatu area (dianggap Resonance Skill DMG) dan menimpakan Deconstruction pada target yang terkena, lalu mengaktifkan Twilight Tango.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.

Deconstruction

Memberikan DMG ke target yang terkena Deconstruction mengabaikan 18% DEF mereka.

Twilight Tango

Saat dalam Twilight Tango, tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Liberation untuk melancarkan Death Knell.
Setiap Death Knell memberi 1 Meta Vectors.
Dengan 4 Meta Vectors, tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Liberation untuk melancarkan Fatal Finale.
- Seluruh Substance dihapus saat mengaktifkan dan mengakhiri Twilight Tango. Tidak dapat melakukan Basic Attack Necessary Measures, Heavy Attack Containment Tactics, dan Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion saat dalam Twilight Tango.

Death Knell

Carlotta menembakkan tembakan kuat dengan musketnya dan memanggil 4 pecahan kristal untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap Resonance Skill DMG.
- Carlotta bergerak ke arah input gerak pada setiap tembakan Death Knell.

Fatal Finale

Memberikan Glacio DMG ke suatu area, dianggap Resonance Skill DMG.
- Twilight Tango berakhir setelah Fatal Finale dilancarkan.

description.en:
After casting Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor, Carlotta can perform Mid-air Attacks while being immune to any DMG or interruptions before the Mid-air Attack deals DMG.
When Carlotta is on the team, the active Resonator's Flight STA cost is reduced by 20%.
description.id:
Setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor, Carlotta dapat melakukan Mid-air Attack dan kebal terhadap DMG atau interupsi apa pun sebelum Mid-air Attack memberikan DMG.
Saat Carlotta berada di tim, biaya STA Flight Resonator yang aktif berkurang 20%.

description.en: Intro Skill Wintertime Aria, Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor, Resonance Liberation Death Knell, and Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion can inflict Deconstruction.
description.id: Intro Skill Wintertime Aria, Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor, Resonance Liberation Death Knell, dan Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion dapat menimpakan Deconstruction.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack - Imminent Oblivion

Carlotta activates Tinted Crystal every 22s.
When Substance is full and Tinted Crystal is activated, hold Normal Attack to consume all Substance and cast Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion, after which Tinted Crystal enters cooldown.
Deal Glacio DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG), and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill Art of Violence by 6s.

Final Bow

When Substance is full, enter the Final Bow state.
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Era of New Wave, Resonance Liberation Death Knell, and Resonance Liberation Fatal Finale by 80%. This effect ends when Carlotta is switched off the field during Twilight Tango or when Twilight Tango ends.

Substance

Carlotta can hold up to 120 points of Substance.
Cannot gain Substance while in Twilight Tango triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore 30 points of Substance upon casting Intro Skill Wintertime Aria.
Restore 10 points of Substance for every 1 Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor.
Restore 10 points of Substance for every 1 Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Basic Attack Necessary Measures.
Consume 1 Moldable Crystal and restore 10 points of Substance upon casting Dodge Counter.

Moldable Crystal

Carlotta can hold up to 6 Moldable Crystals.
Cannot gain Moldable Crystal while in Twilight Tango triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Basic Attack Stage 2.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Heavy Attack.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Mid-air Attack Customary Greetings.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Intro Skill Wintertime Aria.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Resonance Skill Art of Violence.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon a successful Dodge.
description.id:
Heavy Attack - Imminent Oblivion

Carlotta mengaktifkan Tinted Crystal setiap 22 dtk.
Saat Substance penuh dan Tinted Crystal aktif, tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi seluruh Substance dan melancarkan Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion, setelah itu Tinted Crystal memasuki cooldown.
Memberikan Glacio DMG (dianggap Resonance Skill DMG), dan mengurangi cooldown Resonance Skill Art of Violence sebesar 6 dtk.

Final Bow

Saat Substance penuh, memasuki kondisi Final Bow.
Meningkatkan pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Era of New Wave, Resonance Liberation Death Knell, dan Resonance Liberation Fatal Finale sebesar 80%. Efek ini berakhir saat Carlotta diganti keluar dari lapangan selama Twilight Tango atau saat Twilight Tango berakhir.

Substance

Carlotta dapat menyimpan hingga 120 poin Substance.
Tidak dapat memperoleh Substance saat dalam Twilight Tango yang dipicu oleh Resonance Liberation.
Memulihkan 30 poin Substance saat melancarkan Intro Skill Wintertime Aria.
Memulihkan 10 poin Substance untuk setiap 1 Moldable Crystal yang dikonsumsi saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor.
Memulihkan 10 poin Substance untuk setiap 1 Moldable Crystal yang dikonsumsi saat melancarkan Basic Attack Necessary Measures.
Mengonsumsi 1 Moldable Crystal dan memulihkan 10 poin Substance saat melancarkan Dodge Counter.

Moldable Crystal

Carlotta dapat menyimpan hingga 6 Moldable Crystals.
Tidak dapat memperoleh Moldable Crystal saat dalam Twilight Tango yang dipicu oleh Resonance Liberation.
Memulihkan 3 Moldable Crystals saat melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.
Memulihkan 3 Moldable Crystals saat melancarkan Heavy Attack.
Memulihkan 3 Moldable Crystals saat melancarkan Mid-air Attack Customary Greetings.
Memulihkan 3 Moldable Crystals saat melancarkan Intro Skill Wintertime Aria.
Memulihkan 3 Moldable Crystals saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Art of Violence.
Memulihkan 3 Moldable Crystals saat Dodge berhasil.

description.id: Saat Carlotta memberikan DMG ke target yang terkena Deconstruction, Crit. Rate DMG tersebut meningkat sebesar 12,5%. Saat Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor mengenai target yang terkena Dispersion, Carlotta memulihkan tambahan 30 poin Substance.

description.en:
Shots of Resonance Liberation Death Knell deal higher DMG and shoot out double the number of crystal shards, representing a total increase of 186.6% in the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Death Knell.
Shots of Resonance Liberation Death Knell inflict Scattering on targets when hit, during which the target is immobilized. This effect is removed after 1.5s or when the target receives DMG.
description.id:
Tembakan Resonance Liberation Death Knell memberikan DMG yang lebih tinggi dan menembakkan pecahan kristal dua kali lipat, dengan total peningkatan 186,6% pada pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Death Knell.
Tembakan Resonance Liberation Death Knell menimpakan Scattering pada target yang terkena, selama itu target tidak dapat bergerak. Efek ini hilang setelah 1,5 dtk atau saat target menerima DMG.
